description: Owed by bedrock-q67.20.2: the bootstrap shard_key decode keeps a narrow binary_to_term(value, [:safe]) fallback (materializer_bootstrap_phase.ex decode_legacy_shard_tag) for clusters that wrote shard keys before Bedrock.SystemKeys.Values. Every completed recovery re-encodes; remove the fallback once no supported release can carry the old encoding (one release after 0.7).
title: Remove legacy term_to_binary shard-tag fallback from materializer bootstrap
